headlines.title: Marvell (MRVL) Stock Still Carries A Rich Price Despite Its 392% Run
headlines.summary: Marvell Technology has turned into one of the stronger movers in large-cap chips over the past few years. After that run, the key question is whether the current share price lines up with what its earnings can support. Over the past 3 years the stock has gained about 392%, which puts a lot of weight on the idea that Marvell's profit stream can eventually match the optimism baked into that rise.

headlines.title: “Next Trillion-Dollar Company”: Marvell Has Ripped 185% in a Year. Is It Too Late to Buy?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell stock is up 185% in the past year. It was lifted by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s trillion-dollar call, a chip deal with Alphabet’s Google and a fiscal 2031 revenue target of $70 billion to $90 billion.

headlines.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit Among 6 More Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
headlines.summary: Twenty-two companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, after Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna. and Intuit joined the list.

headlines.title: Marvell’s Road to $90B: The 3 Moves Behind the Boldest Target in AI Chips
headlines.summary: Marvell’s custom AI chips and data center connectivity businesses offer multiple growth drivers, but the key question is whether earnings can catch up with its ambitious valuation.

description: Marvell Technology, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides data infrastructure semiconductor solutions and spanning the data center core to network edge in the United States, Argentina, China, India, Israel, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Vietnam, and internationally. The company develops and scales system-on-a-chip architectures, integrating analog, mixed-signal, and digital signal processing functionality. It offers a portfolio of ethernet solutions, including spanning controllers, network adapters, physical transceivers, and switches; single or multiple core processors; and custom application specific integrated circuits, interconnects, fibre channel adapters, and processors. The company also provides interconnect products, including pulse amplitude modulation, coherent and coherent-lite digital signal processors (DSPs), laser drivers, trans-impedance amplifiers, silicon photonics, co-packaged optics, linear pluggable optics chipsets, data center interconnect, active electrical cable DSPs and peripheral component interconnect express retimer solutions; fibre channel products comprising host bus adapters and controllers for server and storage system connectivity; storage controllers for hard disk drives and solid-state-drives; host system interfaces, including serial advanced technology attachment and serial attached SCSI, peripheral component interconnect express, compute express link switches, non-volatile memory express (NVMe), and NVMe over fabrics; and develops ultra accelerator linkTM switches and ethernet for scale-up networking switches. The company serves data centers, communications, and other markets. It offers its products through direct customers and distributors. Marvell Technology, Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware.
